title.zh: ServiceNow单日暴跌27%，AI初创公司Serval融资1.5亿美元挑战其核心业务
title.en: ServiceNow单日暴跌27%，AI初创公司Serval融资1.5亿美元挑战其核心业务

current_state.zh: ServiceNow stock plunged 26.95% (~$42B market cap) on slowing forward contract-revenue growth guidance, the same day AI startup Serval raised $150M led by Sequoia at a $3B valuation with AI agents designed to replace ServiceNow's IT ticketing and workflow software.
